parrafo_1.es: Hot Box Tattoos es un estudio de tatuajes y piercing en Brandon. Reunimos varios artistas bajo un mismo techo, cada uno con su propio estilo, de línea fina a color intenso.
parrafo_1.en: Hot Box Tattoos is a tattoo and piercing studio in Brandon. We bring several artists together under one roof, each with their own style, from fine line to bold color.

parrafo_2.es: 539 reseñas en Google respaldan el trabajo: clientes que destacan la limpieza, la paciencia para explicar cada paso y piercings hechos con cuidado, incluso para los más chicos de la casa.
parrafo_2.en: 539 reviews on Google back up the work: clients highlight the cleanliness, the patience to explain every step, and piercings done with care, even for the youngest clients.

texto.es: Pasa por el estudio o llama y cuéntanos qué quieres: estilo, tamaño y zona del cuerpo.
texto.en: Stop by or call and tell us what you want: style, size and placement.

texto.es: Varios artistas, varios estilos. Te ayudamos a encontrar el que encaja con tu idea.
texto.en: Several artists, several styles. We help you find the one that fits your idea.

texto.es: Trabajo limpio y explicado paso a paso, para tatuajes y para piercing.
texto.en: Clean work explained step by step, for both tattoos and piercing.

texto.es: Sales con instrucciones claras de cuidado, para que la pieza sane bien.
texto.en: You leave with clear aftercare instructions, so the piece heals well.

nota.es: Cada tatuaje se cotiza según el diseño y el tiempo de sesión. Pregunta por el artista y el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every tattoo is quoted based on the design and session time. Ask about the artist and the price, no strings attached.

texto.es: Piezas vibrantes y detalladas, de flores a ilustraciones temáticas.
texto.en: Vibrant, detailed pieces, from flowers to themed illustrations.

texto.es: Tatuajes delicados y minimalistas para una primera pieza o para sumar a tu colección.
texto.en: Delicate, minimal tattoos for a first piece or to add to your collection.

texto.es: Perforación de orejas y piercing en general, incluso para los más chicos, con joyería de calidad.
texto.en: Ear piercing and general piercing, even for younger clients, with quality jewelry.

texto.es: Rediseño de tatuajes antiguos y piezas grandes planeadas en varias sesiones.
texto.en: Redesign of old tattoos and large pieces planned across multiple sessions.

pie.es: ¿Buscas algo distinto? Pregunta en el estudio, seguro alguno de nuestros artistas lo resuelve.
pie.en: Looking for something different? Ask at the studio, one of our artists can likely take it on.

items.quote: Tyler was recommended to me for his clean work and light hand. Most comfortable tattoo session I've ever had. Hands down will recommend him to all my people looking to get a clean tattoo. 10/10 go get ink by Tyler.

Got my belly button pierced by Ray Ray. He was very professional and caring. Gave very thorough directions on how to care for your piercing as well as his personal number for questions or concerns. Prices were very reasonable.

I brought my daughter to get her ears pierced for her 10th birthday. This was one of the rare places that would take young children and they were amazing! Kylee was super friendly and reassuring. We are definitely going to be repeat customers!
